bounds.name: finite_CSI_support
bounds.statement: If CSI support is finite, the sum operator is finite_sum.

bounds.name: absolute_decay_bound
bounds.statement: If contribution magnitudes are bounded by a summable decay sequence, the sum operator is absolutely_convergent.

bounds.name: bounded_truncation
bounds.statement: If non-local accumulation is truncated by an admissibility or distance bound, the sum operator is bounded_truncated_sum.

bounds.name: residue_weighted_decay
bounds.statement: If residue-weighted influence decays below epsilon_null or declared contribution floor, the effective sum is decay_weighted_sum.
